long_description:
Boostly provides everything necessary for restaurants to attract new guests and turn them into regulars. From AI-powered SEO, paid ads, behavioral-based text marketing with gamified engagement, and AI driven reputation management, Boostly provides 10x greater guest engagement when compared to others in the industry.  

Boostly’s patented processes enables them to build opted-in subscriber lists bigger and faster than anyone on the market.
name: Boostly
